name: collapsible-panes
title: Collapsible panes
description: Stacked panes that share the height: open ones split the space and scroll on their own, closed ones fold to a header.
docs: panes is the list: an id, a title, an optional count and actions (buttons for the header, shown while the pane is open) and the content. openIds and onOpenIdsChange control which are open (defaultOpenIds when the component keeps the state); multiple (on by default) lets several share the height, off opens one at a time. The open panes divide the height of the component, so give it a height; each content scrolls inside its pane, and minPaneHeight (120px) is the least height an open pane gets. When there is not room for every open pane at that height, the ones that cannot meet it fold, the last first and never the one a person just opened, and they open again when there is room. Headers are buttons in headings (headingLevel, 3 by default) with aria-expanded and aria-controls; ArrowUp, ArrowDown, Home and End move between them. The content of an open pane takes focus, so the keyboard can scroll it; the content of a folded pane stays mounted and inert, so it keeps its scroll position and its state.
